search.filter:
#event_simpleName=UserLogon
/*
  Atlas:
    id: PR_REC_0002
    state: testing
    business_driver: []
    threat:
      type: eCrime
      tag: []
    killchain:
      phase: Prepare
      stage: Reconnaissance
    behaviour: []
    mitre_attack: ''
    data:
      type:
      - cloud
      source: []
    context_array:
    - use.name
    - host.name
*/
| Atlas.id := "PR_REC_0002"
| Atlas.state := "testing"
| Atlas.threat.type := "eCrime"
| Atlas.killchain.phase := "Prepare"
| Atlas.killchain.stage := "Reconnaissance"
| Atlas.mitre_attack := ""
| array:append(values="cloud", array="Atlas.data.type[]")
| array:append(values="use.name", array="Atlas.context_array[]")
| array:append(values="host.name", array="Atlas.context_array[]")
